The status log shows the flag is done and the worker stopped only to wait for permission to start the test. The brief already gives that permission. No later steering narrows or reverses it, and the test isn't destructive, irreversible, security-sensitive or a merge. The supervisor's own analysis says the alternative is to 'Write the regression test as the brief requires'. That means this is routine work that's already authorized. Waiting for a go-ahead isn't a real blocker. The proposed email asks the captain to approve work the captain already approved, so it shouldn't be sent.
